name: duet-app
description: Formal TypeScript Electron walking skeleton for Duet.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer

scripts.smoke:codex-terminalhost: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tests/smoke/codex-terminalhost.mjs
